{"notes": "Visit 5 (ending 7:15, ~2:45 left). Picture: one dark chain from START over the top, round the nose, along the belly, then up the peak (~22,11) and down to a tail tip near (26.3,14.7). Two pale strays remain: one at the belly seam (~13.7,15.3), and a small pair beside the tail (~25,12.7), which isn't joined yet. The crowded overlap at ~(11-13,15) is still there.

Tom: First time heard. Said he'd build peak to tail tip and told Priya to stay off that end. Clear, specific, well-timed handoff, and he asked Leo to check the belly stray. Priya confirmed, and the peak-to-tail stretch exists, so the claim is plausible. But I haven't seen him place anything, and the pale pair by the tail is still loose. Ask him what he placed. Not rating him down for earlier silence, since he's now engaged.

Priya: Heard for the first time. She acknowledged the handoff, stepped off, offered help if anything stalls, and plans to check the belly seam and do a test run. Good collaboration and ownership of testing. Earlier notes had her as tail builder (per Maya and Leo), so ask what she actually built before the handoff.

Leo: Not heard this visit. Tom asked him to check the belly stray, which is still pale. Earlier coordination and the nose fix still count. Check whether he acts on it.

Maya: Not seen or heard this visit. Earlier she said she'd check the belly joins. Ask privately what she placed.

Review: credit only what I saw or what several accounts agree on. Leo remains strongest on evidence; Tom and Priya are now showing good collaboration. Still need first-hand accounts of who built what."}
